rows.what_the_ink_shows: In crops/7_scan041_L724_formula.jpg, the displayed formula reads |a_n| = O(1) rho^n. The exponent is a small n above and to the right of rho, with clear blank space before it and no minus sign. The adjacent condition is rho > 1, with the comparison visibly pointing right. In crops/7_scan041_L724_disc_radius.jpg, the subsequent prose explicitly says séries convergentes sur un disque de rayon rho > 1 and continues un peu plus grand. Both parts agree with the supplied current TeX.
rows.note: Retain the written positive exponent n and condition rho > 1. The supplied correction proposes |a_n| = O(rho^(-n)) for some rho > 1, or equivalently the written positive-exponent form with a parameter rho < 1, to express the intended decay associated with convergence on a larger disc. That is a mathematical repair of the author’s formula, not an omitted visible minus sign or a misread inequality. This review confirms the ink and does not independently prove the analytic refinement.
